lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills, with the most prominent spots located along the midline. Centroid spacing increases linearly toward the posterior as the body tapers.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to form a rectangular grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of roughly 8-10 low-intensity, high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly within its silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-contrast white punctate markings that are significantly smaller than the primary spots on the lateral flank.
